_comment: Copy to site.json and fill in your own SAP systems. site.json is git-ignored. base_url = the Gateway / ICM HTTPS endpoint (https://<host>:443<instance number>); client = the client (mandt) your users log into. Set verify_tls to false only for internal hosts with self-signed certificates. Optional extra environments (any key) are allowed, e.g. "golden" for the development system's customizing client where repository changes are permitted; "aliases" maps extra names to them.
company_note: Company: 1000 Example Ltd; chart of accounts INT; currency EUR.
